_provenance: Stated by the repo owner in the odysseus maintainers Matrix room, 2026-07-15. Transcribed from the local digest at ~/.matrix-reader/digest/maintainers.md. This is policy, not inference from the git graph - the graph alone cannot tell you WHICH branch a given kind of work belongs on.

branch_policy.quote: Use dev as normal working branch and main as conservative. Touch main for bigger breakage and security fixes / narrow hotfix work.

rules.note: dev is the day-to-day branch and the repo's declared default

rules.for: bigger breakage, security fixes, narrow hotfix work
rules.note: security fixes belong on main, NOT on dev - being based on main is correct here, not a mistake

sensitive_flow.rule: private branch flow - GHSA advisory plus a temporary private fork, not a public PR
sensitive_flow.note: everything less sensitive stays a normal PR; blanket-applying the private flow was rejected as too much churn

push_policy.note: this clone's origin IS the org repo (no fork remote) and Joe has push+triage, so a plain push lands upstream. We push NOTHING here.
